focus moves into the dialog address field

empty submit is blocked and the field is flagged invalid
invalid address shows a role=alert error and keeps the value
local/private addresses are rejected
an unreadable site gives a friendly error
working state: button disabled, aria-busy, "Reading the site…" and a status message
success redirects with a "Filed … under …" notice naming the categories
